recommendations.title: Raise the ICAP scan timeout above the archive scan time
recommendations.action: Have the customer raise the ICAP Server scan timeout from 60s to 300s, then retest with the 80 MB zip.
recommendations.rationale: Log shows ICAP Server gives up after 60s waiting for Core, which matches failures only on large archives.

sources.label: ICAP Server: configuring scan timeouts
sources.snippet: The request timeout defines how long ICAP Server waits for a Core scan result before returning an error.

sources.label: KB: ICAP 500 after 60 seconds on large archives

recommendations.title: Check Core archive handling limits for large zips
recommendations.action: Review Core archive extraction limits (file count, total extracted size) for the customer's workflow profile.
recommendations.rationale: Zips with hundreds of pages may hit extraction limits or simply scan slowly, independent of the ICAP timeout.

recommendations.title: Known issue: ICAP preview size and large uploads
recommendations.action: Check whether the open ticket on large uploads applies to ICAP Server 5.8.0.
recommendations.rationale: A similar report exists for 5.8.x; confirms whether a hotfix or workaround is documented.
